description:
Full-text search inside the pages (matn and footnotes) of installed books. `match` picks how the query is read:
- words (default): every word required, ranked by relevance; options add morphology, wildcards, chronological sort. An all-words miss retries with fewer words (relaxed_min_match).
- phrase: the words consecutively (a quotation). near: all words within `distance`, any order. Both verified in the full page text.
- exact: diacritics, hamza/alef forms or digit systems kept distinct («أحمد» not «احمد», «عِلْم» not «عَلَم», ٢٥٥ not 255); set at least one `preserve` flag.
- boolean: every all_of term, one or more any_of, no none_of (الوقف with المسجد or المقبرة, without البيع); one query over the whole index, so total_hits is exact and exclusion exhaustive.
- batch: 1–24 scoped `queries` run at once, merged and deduped by page (probe_ids); no paging, cut at max_total_passages.
Rules: a parameter of another match value is refused. Page with limit/offset until has_more is false. scope.madhab drops books of unknown school: omit it for comparative questions; set scope.citable_only before quoting a page number. Follow-up rounds: exclude_pages / exclude_work_group_ids keep out pages already used and other printings of the same work. EMPTY_SCOPE: the scope matched no book.
Instead: chapter headings → shamela_find(kind='heading'); titles → shamela_find(kind='book'); verses → shamela_lookup_quran(mode='search'); a hadith's wording → shamela_lookup_hadith(mode='search').
Example: {query:'استصناع', scope:{category_ids:[17]}}.

all_of.description: The three lists are ONE Lucene BooleanQuery over the whole index: all_of MUST, any_of SHOULD (at least one), none_of MUST_NOT. AND — terms that must ALL appear on the page; a multi-word term is itself AND-searched (its words co-occur; not a phrase). Leave empty to rely on any_of, but not both: BAD_ARG. Results are ranked by relevance. E.g. {match:'boolean', all_of:['الوقف'], any_of:['المسجد','المقبرة'], none_of:['البيع'], scope:{category_ids:[17]}}. (match=boolean only.)

any_of.description: OR — at least ONE of these terms must appear on the page. Union of every term's hit set, then intersected with the all_of result. Leave empty to rely on all_of. (match=boolean only.)

deadline_ms.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole batch. Probes still running when it expires are reported with status='timeout' and contribute nothing. A timeout is NOT a negative finding — it means the question was not fully asked. Default: 8000. (match=batch only.)

distance.description: For match='near': maximum word span from the FIRST to the LAST query word, counted inclusively — 1 = adjacent, 2 allows one word between two query words. Ignored for match='phrase'. Suits fiqh terms that sit close but not adjacent: {match:'near', query:'بيع قبض', distance:5, scope:{category_ids:[17]}}. Default: 5. (match=phrase|near only.)

exclude_author_ids.description: Exclude every book by these authors. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

exclude_book_ids.description: Book ids to keep out of the results entirely. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

exclude_category_ids.description: Exclude every book on these shelves. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

exclude_pages.description: Exact pages to keep out — the pages a previous round already returned. Excluding these rather than whole books is what lets a follow-up search find MORE evidence in a book that has already contributed some. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

exclude_work_group_ids.description: Exclude every catalogue entry of these works — all printings at once. This is the one to use after a round returned «صحيح البخاري - ط السلطانية»: excluding that book_id alone leaves the other seven entries of group 1681 free to return the same text again as if it were a second source. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20). (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

match.description: Selects what the call does: words | phrase | near | exact | boolean | batch. Default words.

max_total_passages.description: Hard cap on merged rows returned. Rows are ordered by match quality then probe agreement before the cut, so the cap drops the weakest evidence rather than an arbitrary tail. `truncated` says whether it fired. Default: 60. (match=batch only.)

none_of.description: NOT — pages containing ANY of these terms are excluded, across the whole index (a MUST_NOT clause, not a subtraction inside a sampled window). Optional. (match=boolean only.)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Use with `limit` to page through large result sets. The response includes `has_more` and `next_offset` to drive paging. Default: 0. (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

options.description: Search options: morphology, wildcards, sort, search_in (body/foot), relax_when_empty. Defaults to body+foot, no toggles. preserve_* redirect to shamela_search(match='exact'). E.g. {query:'كلم', options:{morphology:true}}. (match=words only.)

morphology.description: Search Arabic root forms via the AlKhalil morphological analyzer. Useful when looking for all word forms (يكتب، كاتب، مكتوب…) of a root (كتب). Cannot be combined with `wildcards`. Default: false.

preserve_diacritics.description: Returns OPTION_NOT_SUPPORTED here — the index itself stores no diacritics, so this search cannot honor them. Use `shamela_search(match='exact', {preserve:{preserve_diacritics:true}})`, which re-checks each candidate against the book's raw text. Default: false.

preserve_digits.description: Returns OPTION_NOT_SUPPORTED here — the index unifies Arabic-Indic and Western digits. Use `shamela_search(match='exact', {preserve:{preserve_digits:true}})` to distinguish ٢٥٥ from 255. Default: false.

preserve_hamza.description: Returns OPTION_NOT_SUPPORTED here — the index folds ٱآأإ→ا before storing. Use `shamela_search(match='exact', {preserve:{preserve_hamza:true}})` to distinguish «أحمد» from «احمد». Default: false.

relax_when_empty.description: When the AND of every term matches no page, retry requiring only the largest number of your terms that some page does carry, and report it in `relaxed_min_match`. Only ever fires on a result that would otherwise be empty, and never drops below half your terms. Set false to keep a strict all-terms-or-nothing search. Default: true.

search_in.description: Which page sections to search. 'body' = matn (المتن), 'foot' = footnotes (الحواشي). Default is both. Reader comments (التعليقات) are NOT searchable — Shamela keeps them in database/user/data.db, outside the Lucene index, so passing 'comment' returns OPTION_NOT_SUPPORTED rather than silently matching nothing. To search chapter titles use the separate `shamela_find(kind='heading')` tool.

sort.description: Result order. 'relevance' (default) ranks by how well the page matches — the right answer to 'find me X'. 'chronological' orders by the author's death year, then book, then page, so the EARLIEST sources come first — the right answer to 'who says this first' or 'how does this idea travel through the tradition'. Undated books sort last.

wildcards.description: Interpret `*` (zero-or-more characters) and `?` (exactly-one character) within tokens. Examples: `صيا*` matches صيام/صيامهم, `ص?م` matches صام/صوم/صمم. Leading wildcards (`*ابن`) are slow. Cannot combine with `morphology`. With this OFF, `*` and `?` are treated as ordinary punctuation and split the word, so a stray one no longer zeroes the search. CAVEAT on prefixes: the index folds some words as a WHOLE — «مائة» is stored as «ميه», «داوود» as «داود» — and a wildcard stem is folded without the letters the wildcard replaced, so `مائ*` becomes `ماي*` and reaches مائع/مائدة but NOT مائة. When a prefix search returns less than you expect for a word like these, search the full word without a wildcard instead. Default: false.

preserve.description: Which distinctions to enforce when each candidate is verified; at least one must be true (none = BAD_ARG), and every unset feature folds. E.g. {query:'أحمد', preserve:{preserve_hamza:true}}, {query:'عِلْم', preserve:{preserve_diacritics:true}}. (match=exact only.)

preserve_diacritics.description: Enforce التشكيل exactly: «عِلْم» will not match «عَلَم». The query's own diacritics are honored verbatim. Default: false.

preserve_digits.description: Distinguish digit systems: Arabic-Indic «٢٥٥» will not match Western «255» (and vice-versa). Default: false.

preserve_hamza.description: Enforce hamza/alef forms exactly: «أحمد» will not match «احمد»; ٱآأإ, ؤ, ئ, ء, ى, ة are all kept distinct. Default: false.

queries.description: Several wordings of one question, run concurrently to assemble its evidence; results are merged, deduped by (book_id, page_id) and attributed to the probes that found each page (`probe_ids`): a page several probes found is corroboration across wordings, not a duplicate. Every probe's scope must carry book_ids, author_ids, category_ids or madhab, else the whole call is BAD_ARG. A probe that errors or outlasts deadline_ms is reported in its own slot and sets `incomplete`: a thin result is then not the library being silent. E.g. {queries:[{query:'الوتر واجب', scope:{category_ids:[14,19]}}, {query:'حكم صلاة الوتر', mode:'near', scope:{madhab:['hanafi']}}]}. (match=batch only.)

distance.description: For mode='near' only: maximum word span from the FIRST to the LAST query word, inclusive (1 = adjacent). Ignored for 'and' and 'phrase'. Default: 5.

exclude_author_ids.description: Exclude every book by these authors.

exclude_book_ids.description: Book ids to keep out of the results entirely.

exclude_category_ids.description: Exclude every book on these shelves.

exclude_pages.description: Exact pages to keep out — the pages a previous round already returned. Excluding these rather than whole books is what lets a follow-up search find MORE evidence in a book that has already contributed some.

exclude_work_group_ids.description: Exclude every catalogue entry of these works — all printings at once. This is the one to use after a round returned «صحيح البخاري - ط السلطانية»: excluding that book_id alone leaves the other seven entries of group 1681 free to return the same text again as if it were a second source.

id.description: Your label for this probe, echoed back on every row it found (`probe_ids`). Defaults to the probe's index, e.g. 'p0'.

limit.description: Rows this probe may contribute before dedupe; `max_total_passages` then caps the merged total. Default: 10.

mode.description: 'and' (default) = the regular all-terms page search. 'phrase' = the words as a CONSECUTIVE phrase — use it when the caller is holding a quotation. 'near' = within `distance` words, any order.

query.description: Arabic search text. In mode='and' every word is required (each may match body or footnotes); in mode='phrase' the words must be consecutive; in mode='near' within `distance` words in any order.

scope.description: REQUIRED. Must carry at least one of book_ids / author_ids / category_ids / madhab. An unscoped probe is rejected: term-frequency ranking over all 8,594 books returns whichever book repeats the word most («التيمم» puts a poetry anthology ahead of the fiqh manuals), which is not the question being asked.

query.description: [match=words] Arabic words, ANDed; each may match in body or footnotes, e.g. {query:'الكلام'}. A word the library lacks in your spelling is searched in the spelling the books use and reported in `respelled_terms`: say so when you quote. [match=phrase] The words as a consecutive phrase, e.g. {query:'خيار المجلس'}. [match=near] The words within `distance` of each other, in any order. Phrase and near candidates come from an AND search and are verified in the full page text up to 1,500 pages or 12 s, so `total_verified` is not a library total; narrow `scope` when `candidate_cap_hit`. [match=exact] The exact string, typed WITH the diacritics / hamza form / digit system to enforce (it is not auto-diacritized) and matched as written; `preserve` decides which distinctions count. An AND search gathers at most 100 candidate pages and each is checked against the book's raw text; results keep candidate-relevance order. (match=words|phrase|near|exact only.)

response_format.description: Format of the human-readable text: 'markdown' (default) for display; 'json' the same data as one JSON code block; 'none' only a one-line pointer, leaving structuredContent as the whole answer. structuredContent is always returned, so a caller that parses it should pass 'none': the character budget counts both channels, and the unread copy otherwise spends most of it. Requires the 'response_format.none' capability (see shamela_get_brief).

scope.description: Restrict to books, authors, categories, a Hijri period or the other filters below; get ids from shamela_find(kind='category') or shamela_find(kind='name'). Strongly recommended on common words for match=phrase|near (verification stops after 1,500 candidate pages or 12 s) and match=exact (at most 100 candidate pages are verified): a narrow scope is what lets that window cover the topic. match=boolean: an unscoped search over a large library is exhaustive but slow, so scope narrows the question and speeds it up. (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

author_ids.description: Restrict to books by these authors. Includes co-authored books. Use `shamela_find(kind='name', type='author')` to find IDs.

book_ids.description: Restrict to these book IDs. Use `shamela_find(kind='name')` or `shamela_list_downloaded_books` to find IDs. Combine with other scope keys for intersection.

book_type.description: Restrict to these kinds of entry (master.db.book.book_type — the same filter row Shamela's own 'اختيار كتاب' window shows). 'transcript' (تفريغات) is a transcribed lecture series, not an authored book, and 'thesis'/'electronic' are likewise not printed works — excluding them sharpens a scholarly search. Of 8,594 entries, 7,334 are 'book'; 1,260 are not.

category_ids.description: Restrict to books in these categories. Categories are flat in master.db (no parent_id, no transitive subtree expansion). Use `shamela_find(kind='category')` to find IDs.

citable_only.description: Keep only books whose page numbering matches a real printed edition (master.db.book.printed == 1 — Shamela's «يوافق المطبوع»). The other 1,417 entries are paginated by Shamela automatically, so their page numbers are NOT a citable reference to any published edition. Set this true whenever the answer will quote a page number as a citation. Default: false.

downloaded_only.description: Restrict to books actually downloaded on this user's machine (master.db.book.major_ondisk > 0). Critical for honest research scoping when using `shamela_search(match='words')` — only downloaded books have searchable content. Default: false.

madhab.description: Restrict to books of these Sunni schools. master.db has NO madhab field, so this is resolved two ways: a book filed under a school-specific category (الفقه الحنفي/المالكي/الشافعي/الحنبلي) counts directly, and otherwise the MAIN AUTHOR's school is used, inferred from the categories that author's own books are filed under. That second path is what reaches مسائل فقهية and الفقه العام, where Shamela records no school — it raises madhab coverage of the fiqh shelves from 27% to 43%. Books whose school cannot be established are EXCLUDED by this filter, so do not read absence as 'no school said this'; for comparative questions leave madhab unset and scope by category instead.

period_from.description: Hijri year, inclusive lower bound. Matches book.book_date (composition year) OR author.death_number (death year). Pair with period_to.

period_to.description: Hijri year, inclusive upper bound. Pair with period_from.

search_in.description: [match=phrase|near] Which page sections to verify the phrase in: body (matn), foot (footnotes). Default both; a hit's `matched_in_section` says where it was found. [match=boolean] Which page sections every clause (all_of, any_of and none_of alike) looks in: body (matn), foot (footnotes). Default ['body','foot']. (match=phrase|near|boolean only.)

shape.description: How much of each hit to return. 'full' (default): every field, snippets included — ask for it when the answer will QUOTE the page. 'brief': book_id/page_id, printed_page, match_quality and matched_in_section, book metadata hoisted into a top-level `books` keyed by book_id, NO snippet — which pages, how well each matched and how to cite them, for a fraction of the characters, so far more rows survive the budget. 'index': book_id/page_id only, to choose what to read before paying to read it. Requires the 'shape.full_brief_index' capability (see shamela_get_brief). (match=words|phrase|near|batch only.)

name: shamela_search

books.description: shape 'brief' only: book metadata keyed by book_id, hoisted off the rows. (match=words|phrase|near|batch only.)

by_book.description: Returned rows per book name. (match=batch only.)

candidate_cap_hit.description: True when the candidate window filled up: more matches may exist outside it; narrow the scope. (match=phrase|near|exact only.)

coverage.description: Roll-up of hits by_category and by_century (the whole sample), by_book and by_author (the largest top_n only, so they do not sum to it) and edition_groups (one work under several catalogue entries: one source, not corroboration). A census only when sample_is_complete; otherwise a top-scoring sample of sampled_hits. (match=words only.)

distance.description: Word span used for mode 'near'. (match=phrase|near only.)

edition_groups.description: Works present under several catalogue entries in these rows: read each as one source. (match=batch only.)

exclusion.description: What the `exclude_*` parameters removed. Present only when used. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

unknown.description: Excluded ids the catalogue does not hold, per dimension.

has_more.description: True when another page exists; call again with `next_offset`. (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

incomplete.description: True when any probe errored or timed out: a thin result is then not the library being silent. (match=batch only.)

morphology_expanded_to.description: options.morphology only: exactly what was searched, per word. Roots are ambiguous and every reading is kept («كتب» also searches تبب/توب/وتب, perdition and repentance), so results are a SUPERSET of the word asked for. (match=words only.)

morphology_fallback.description: True when the literal search found nothing and was re-run with morphology (root forms). (match=words only.)

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page. Absent on the last page. (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

normalized_tokens.description: The query after Arabic folding, as actually searched. (match=words only.)

notes.description: Caveats about how the expression was evaluated. (match=boolean only.)

offset.description: Offset this page started at. (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

paging_ceiling.description: Deepest offset paging can reach. Present only when the request went past it: narrow the scope instead of paging further. (match=words|boolean only.)

preserve.description: The preserve_* flags enforced on this call. (match=exact only.)

probes.description: One report per probe, in request order. (match=batch only.)

error.description: Why the probe failed, when status is 'error'.

match_quality.description: Best match_quality among this probe's rows.

qualifiers.description: status 'ok' only: the same caveats a single search returns (null = not applicable to this probe's mode or scope). A probe without qualifiers was not searched: never read its silence as the library's.

returned.description: Rows this probe contributed before dedupe.

scope_count.description: Books in this probe's resolved scope.

status.description: 'ok', 'error' or 'timeout'. Only 'ok' means the probe was actually searched.

total_hits.description: Matches this probe found in its scope.

relaxed_min_match.description: Set when no page held every word: hits carry at least this many of `relaxed_of_terms`. (match=words only.)

relaxed_of_terms.description: Word count the relaxed match is measured against. (match=words only.)

respelled_terms.description: {typed, searched_instead, hits}: a word absent as typed was searched in the spelling the books use. (match=words only.)

results.description: [match=words|phrase|near] Matching pages. shape 'full': book_id, book_name, author_name, category, book_date, work_group_id, madhab fields, page_id, printed_page, matched_in, match_quality ('exact_phrase' | 'near' | 'all_terms' | 'relaxed': a near miss is not a located quotation), matched_in_section ('body' | 'footnote' | 'both'; 'footnote' = the editor's voice, not the author's), snippet_body/snippet_foot (<mark> around matches). shape 'brief' drops book metadata into `books`; 'index' keeps ids only. [match=exact] Verified pages: book_id, book_name, author_name, category, book_date, page_id, printed_page, matched_in (sections holding the exact form), snippet. [match=boolean] Matching pages: book_id, book_name, author_name, category, book_date, madhab fields, page_id, printed_page, matched_in, matched_terms, snippet_body, snippet_foot. [match=batch] Merged page rows (as shamela_search(match='words'), per `shape`) plus probe_ids (every probe that found the page), ordered by match_quality then probe agreement. A 'footnote' matched_in_section is the editor's voice.

returned.description: Rows in `results` on this call. (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

scope_count.description: Books in the resolved scope; -1 when unscoped. (match=words|phrase|near|boolean only.)

scope_resolution.description: Requested book_ids split into resolved and `dropped` (not in the catalogue, never searched). (match=words|phrase|near only.)

terms_truncated.description: True when the query had more words than are searched. (match=words only.)

total_candidates_scanned.description: Candidate pages verified against the page text. (match=phrase|near|exact only.)

total_hits.description: [match=words] Every match in scope, not just the rows returned. [match=boolean] Exact count of pages matching the whole expression. (match=words|boolean only.)

total_unique_passages.description: Distinct pages found across all probes, before the max_total_passages cut. (match=batch only.)

total_verified.description: Matches confirmed within the scanned window, not a library total. (match=phrase|near|exact only.)

unattributable_books.description: Books excluded by scope.madhab because no school can be established for them. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

zero_due_to_exclusion.description: True when pages matched but every one was excluded: not evidence of absence. (match=words|phrase|near only.)

zero_hit_terms.description: Query words with no entry in the library as spelled. A zero then reflects spelling, not the topic. (match=words|phrase|near|exact|boolean only.)

title: Search page text (words, phrase, exact, boolean, batch)
